note.aapt1: The reference: vinyl-check was built and checked with this record, so every finding is available.
note.unitra_wt2: Two LPs. Closest to the AAPT 1 among the records sold today; the anti-skating ramp goes up to +10 dB. Side A (sweeps) is not needed.
note.clearaudio_smart: Side B (tracking and resonance in steps) is not recognised yet. The bands on side A are short (about 10 s).
note.clearaudio_trackability: The tracking bands come in steps, not as a ramp, and are not recognised yet. Side B starts with an endless silent groove and is not part of the guided measurement.
note.ortofon: Only the 1 kHz tones on one channel at a time are recognised (azimuth); the sweeps run on one channel only and the tracking bands come in steps.
note.elipson: Its 1 kHz tone on both channels is at −20 dB, so it is no reference; the spot tones on side B are not needed.
note.hifinews: The bands sit between locked grooves, tracking comes in 300 Hz steps and the resonance bands are made for listening: vinyl-check cannot measure it as a side.
note.cardas: Made for demagnetising and burning in; parts are cut at a different speed: vinyl-check cannot measure it.
